newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France leaves interest rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France leaves interest rates unchanged.

text.p: The French central bank left key interest rates unchanged after a meeting of its monetary policy council Thursday, just two days after the U.S. Federal Reserve decided to hike rates for the first time in two years.
The Bank of France left the intervention rate unchanged at 3.10 percent and the five-to-10-day rate untouched at 4.60 percent. The intervention rate was last cut, from 3.15 percent, Jan. 30.
